---
title: Changelog
---

Release history is maintained in the [GitHub releases](https://github.com/paneltime/paneltime/releases).

## 1.2.x

The 1.2 series includes releases from 1.2.0 through 1.2.73. Consult the
release history for the exact patch-level notes.

## v2 (in development)

- Introduces the constructor plus `.fit()` API.
- Returns a public `Summary` results object from `.fit()`.
- Groups fit configuration into explicit per-call options.
- Adds symbolic SymPy heteroskedasticity functions and checked ExprTk codegen.
- Adds an instantiable `LikelihoodModel` extension point with numerical
  derivative fallback.
